keys: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied authorized hand-painted Chinese swordsman character sheet into the actual unarmed, unequipped male base body for a 2D game (one reusable model, three registered full-body poses). The source is the edit target and reference for exact facial identity, natural adult proportions, pose, camera angle, joints, hands and visual style. Keep the same adult Chinese man, about 34, small dark topknot, swept black hair, short dark beard along jaw, angular nose and brow; wiry fit build, anatomically convincing, understated ink-and-muted-ochre gouache color blocking consistent with the source, no glossy rendered muscles. He wears ONLY one simple pair of opaque plain charcoal-brown fitted boxer briefs, short leg hem high on the thigh, narrow matte waistband, same shape every pose, no markings or fly detail. Bare torso, arms, wrists, thighs, lower legs, ankles and FEET with toes. Empty hands, remove sword, hilt, bracers, wraps, boots, sash, loose trousers, cape and cast shadows completely. Neutral production anatomical base for fitting armor. Keep the EXACT horizontal arrangement and stance landmarks of the reference: left idle looking right, middle wide-footed ready gaze right right-hand holding an invisible handle at waist, right adult man striking to the right as seen from back-three-quarter with arm extended and other hand back. Center of feet, head height, relative pose sizes, foot contact line stay aligned to the REFERENCE; preserve space between silhouettes. No captions, no text, no effects, no floor or ground strokes. True transparent background, full bodies, isolated, uncropped head and all toes, each pose separated clearly. Single wide landscape sprite sheet, 2:1, studio-quality original ink illustration.
walk: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent 2D animation sprite sheet, eight distinct full-body frames arranged 4 evenly spaced columns by 2 rows in reading order with every toe, hair and hand preserved. First image is the layout and exact pose target: complete walk cycle. Show clear alternating left/right support, foot contact, passing and swing, the far arm counter-swings. Second image is the FINAL male model reference, match his face, adult lean proportions, skin color, black topknot, short dark beard, ink edges, gouache shading, and PLAIN snug charcoal brown boxer briefs exactly. Paint the same adult male in all eight cells, barefoot, empty hands, only the same opaque short boxer briefs, exposed wrists, ankles and shoulders. Remove ALL external clothes, belts, wraps, footwear, weapons and effects. Match head, pelvis, foot-contact sequence and silhouette of the movement in input 1. Preserve front vs rear limb ordering even when legs cross. This is an understated historical ink game character, not a glossy comic book. True transparent gutters, padding between poses. No backdrop, floor, cast shadows, labels, frame borders or text. Wide landscape canvas.

front: 以参考图中左侧站立的成年男刀客为同一角色，绘制单人正面全身换装底稿。视角严格正面平视，头、胸骨、肚脐和骨盆朝前，双眼直视，肩髋平正，双脚自然分开站在同一水平线上，双臂自然下垂略微离开躯干，手指放松。保留原本的东亚面孔、浓眉、下颌短胡须、束起的小发髻和精瘦成年体型；使用原图的墨线、暖赭肤色和纸感手绘阴影。人物只穿与原图一致的深棕色不透明平角短内裤，赤脚、空手。从发髻顶到脚趾完整入画，单人居中，竖幅，四边留白，真正透明背景，无地面、投影、标签和道具。
